text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...—
(WHOOSH...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh...!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (I feel it. The surrounding heat... the sounds... I can see everything—even myself.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Fierce and wild—
my unmistakable, true nature.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(My heart leaps at the race. Burning for victory...
This is... who I am!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —The path... I can see it...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dura...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah...! 
Duramente...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it felt different from before.
Duramente's movements...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Could it be that she's... trying to evolve even further from here?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“—Next time...
might the strongest finally be crowned...?”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That's right, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have already
put victory in check.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't care.
This wild fury swirling in my heart――is right.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (I didn't reach it. But... I can see the form it ought to take.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—I can challenge it.
Finally, the time has come...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Still looking ahead, are we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My Classic races end here.
...I've found plenty of things to work on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no problem!
With the summer training camp coming up, I'll get even stronger.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente-san.
You're not going to stop either... are you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...As for me,
next is the Kikuka Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dura-san is going... overseas,
right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess our rematch is on hold, huh?
I've gotta get even stronger too!"
(Uwooooah...!)

Amidst the roaring crowd, I couldn't utter a single sound.
Duramente's run is burned into my eyes.
A new pinnacle of strength, the run she strives for—

"If we polish those legs, surely...
She will be the one—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Her eyes are sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I lost.
Even so... did you see something in me?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way.
Moving past this defeat—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's go
fulfill our promise.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —To the world.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associates
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente!
Great job in the Japanese Derby!

Upon returning to the waiting room, I was greeted with thunderous applause.
I spotted a few faces I'd seen at New Year's greetings...
It seemed members of the family clan had come to watch too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: After you took the time to come all the way out here, to show you such a pathetic result... I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
You did well. Your racing career is far from over...
All that matters is winning the next race.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Still, that really got my blood pumping!
Sports truly are wonderful, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate B
text_block_list.text: "There's still the final crown, the Kikuka Sho! Duramente-san is just getting started."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I may have lost, but... I felt a solid sense of progress. Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—After this,
we will take on the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.'"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associates
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text: At last, to the world...!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate B
text_block_list.text:
"The pinnacle that everyone has dreamed of...
and yet, could never reach until nowâ"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I shall stand at the starting line.
Upon the pride of this bloodline."
